shellCommands.command: git diff && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -not -path './.git/*' -not -name package-lock.json -print && cat package.json

for f in next.config.ts tsconfig.json lib/products.ts app/*.tsx app/globals.css 'app/product/[slug]/page.tsx'; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; done; ls node_modules | head -50; cat node_modules/next/package.json | grep '"version"'; cat node_modules/react/package.json | grep '"version"'

cd node_modules/next; ls dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rl "ViewTransition" dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head -20; grep -o "export.\{0,80\}ViewTransition[^,;]*" dist/compiled/react/cjs/react.development.js | head; grep -n "ViewTransition" dist/compiled/react/cjs/react.development.js | head

cd /workspace; grep '"version"' node_modules/@types/react/package.json; grep -ln "ViewTransition" node_modules/@types/react/*.d.ts; grep -n "ViewTransition\b\|function addTransitionType\|interface ViewTransitionProps" node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts | head; grep -rn "transitionTypes" node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/link.d.ts | head -3

python3 - <<'EOF' p='app/product/[slug]/page.tsx' s=open(p).read() s=s.replace("import { Suspense } from 'react'\n","import { Suspense, ViewTransition } from 'react'\n") s=s.replace("import { notFound } from 'next/navigation'\n","import { notFound } from 'next/navigation'\nimport { PageTransition } from '../../PageTransition'\n") old=s[s.index(" return (\n
\n
← Back to products
} >
) } ''' s=s.replace(old,new) open(p,'w').write(s) EOF git diff 'app/product/[slug]/page.tsx'
which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; git status --short
rm -rf .next tsconfig.tsbuildinfo next-env.d.ts && git checkout tsconfig.json && git status --short
